QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (the shipped default) | libc `calloc`, by macro | `include/mbedtls/platform.h:163-167`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build (PLATFORM_MEMORY off) mbedtls_calloc resolves to libc calloc by macro. The same row implies mbedtls_free does too, and the answer describes function-pointer indirection only for the other configs.
